verdict.rationale: Asana ships automations (rules and AI Studio no-code automations), so this axis applies, but nothing in the evidence documents versioning, review/diff, or rollback of those automations. The agent audit trail and the API deprecation headers (Asana-Enable/Asana-Disable) are adjacent features: they cover agent governance and API behavior changes, not version control for a user's automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
